summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by CNH Capital Receivables LLC as depositor for CNH Equipment Trust 2026-B, reporting the public issuance of multiple classes of asset-backed notes (Class A-1, A-2a, A-2b, A-3, A-4) under an existing shelf registration. The filing includes legal and tax opinions from Greenberg Traurig LLP. There are no special-situation elements such as M&A, tender, restructuring, or board changes. It is a standard structured finance transaction for equipment loan securitization. No deal terms, premiums, or activist activity are present. This is a shelf takedown, not a special situation.
